instruction: Candid outdoor medium full photograph of a grassy park with trees. In the foreground, the woman in the black beanie (R5) in a red t-shirt and blue jeans leans back in a deep squat, pulling hard on a yellow rope. On the right, the man in the red polo (R3) in a red polo and blue jeans pulls the rope with his mouth wide open in a shout of exertion. The bald man (R2) is partially visible behind the woman, supporting the pull. Together, they strain against the yellow rope in a tug-of-war match. Soft, natural daylight filters through the trees, casting gentle shadows.
elements: R5 leans back in a deep squat while pulling hard on the yellow rope
R2 is behind R5 and supports the pull
R3 pulls on the yellow rope while shouting with his mouth wide open
R5, R2, and R3 strain against the yellow rope in a tug-of-war
the yellow rope is the contact object being pulled
the scene is a grassy park with trees
